title: EthenaPay vs sUSDe: Rates to Oct 8, 2026
headline: Did EthenaPay pay more than staked USDe?
name: EthenaPay and sUSDe review
description: sUSDe paid 4.83% a year in September 2026. EthenaPay's rates were higher within the Daily Boost caps and lower above them, and level across all balances.
imageAlt: Line chart of 38 days from September 1 to October 8, 2026. sUSDe's rate a year after compounding ranged between 4.49% on September 5 and 5.28% on October 1. Step lines show EthenaPay's rates, about 6.07% for Pro and VIP balances within their caps, about 5.02% for the first $5,000 of a Standard balance, and a base rate of 4.0% until September 16 and 4.5% from September 17. Both tier lines dip on September 16, to 5.56% and 4.52%. sUSDe stayed above the base rate and below the Pro and VIP rate on every day and paid more than the Standard rate on 10 days.
